summary: Frontend-only UI regression after luxury dark-navy/gold site-wide redesign + invoice PDF export + one-click email invoice + SMTP settings. ALL UI regression checks PASS. Login → Dashboard renders with dark navy/gold theme, no compile overlay, no blank page, no JS pageerrors. All 4 KPI stat cards (stat-income, stat-expense, vat-due-amount, stat-next-deadline), 6-month bar chart, myDATA panel, recent invoices/expenses lists visible. Topbar shows page title + live clock (topbar-clock) + user avatar (topbar-user). All 8 sidebar nav items (nav-invoices/expenses/vat/payroll/mydata/tax-calendar/clients/settings) present and navigate correctly; every page renders without JS errors or error overlays. Invoices: 4 view + 4 pdf row buttons render; row PDF download succeeds (ΤΠΥ-2026-0004.pdf), InvoiceDetailDialog opens with invoice-detail-pdf-button and invoice-detail-email-button; detail PDF download succeeds; email button shows expected Greek toast 'Δεν έχουν ρυθμιστεί τα στοιχεία αποστολής email...' (SMTP unconfigured — expected). New-invoice dialog opens with save-invoice-button visible. Expenses & Clients pages render with data and Νέο/Νέος buttons. Settings: all 10 new fields (settings-address/phone/email/iban/bank/smtp-host/smtp-port/smtp-user/smtp-password/smtp-from-name) render; save-settings-button persists ('Οι ρυθμίσεις αποθηκεύτηκαν'); settings-test-email-button shows expected Greek toast 'Συμπληρώστε πρώτα email και App Password στις ρυθμίσεις SMTP.' Payroll, ΦΠΑ, myDATA, Φορολ. Ημερολόγιο all render without errors.

action_items: (LOW / a11y) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to InvoiceDetailDialog and new-invoice Dialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Luxury redesign (lux-card, font-brand, gold-rule, stagger animations) applied cleanly across all pages — no JSX breakage detected from the batch sed replacements.
PDF download flow correctly uses fetch+blob with Authorization header (verified via successful downloads with correct Greek filenames).
SMTP failure paths return Greek error toasts as designed; 400 responses are user-facing configuration errors, not bugs.
Topbar live clock + Greek date formatting works (Τετάρτη 15 Ιουλίου 2026 / 1:07:59 π.μ. observed).
seed_data_creation: None new. DB already has 4 issued invoices + 4 expenses + 4 clients from previous iterations.
